definitions.explanation: A condition of having frequent loose or watery bowel movements.

examples.japanese: {下痢|げり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎて→食べ過ぎる：21686_tabesugiru⟧{下痢|げり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I got diarrhea from eating too much.

examples.japanese: ⟦{下痢止|げりど}め→下痢止め：30275_geridome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}みすぎて→飲み過ぎる：22592_nomisugiru⟧{下痢|げり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。

examples.english: If the diarrhea continues, you should go to the hospital.

notes:
{下痢|げり} refers to frequent loose or watery bowel movements. A common medical term that learners need for describing symptoms at a doctor's visit.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {下痢|げり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have diarrhea
- {下痢|げり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get diarrhea
- {下痢|げり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: diarrhea continues
- {下痢|げり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: diarrhea won't stop

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{下痢止|げりど}め→下痢止め：30275_geridome⟧: anti-diarrhea medicine
- {下痢|げり}⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧: diarrhea symptoms

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{便秘|べんぴ}→便秘：05383_benpi⟧: constipation (opposite)
- ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}す→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧: to have an upset stomach
- ⟦{腹痛|ふくつう}→腹痛：05019_fukutsuu⟧: stomachache
- ⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧: food poisoning

AT THE DOCTOR:
Useful phrase: {下痢|げり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いています→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (I've been having continuous diarrhea).
